# Product Mgr II, Subscriber Data — Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology

---
**Job ID:** 10162575
**Date Posted:** Nov 6, 2026
**Date Applied:** Nov 7, 2026
**Salary Range:** $119,200–$159,800 per year — Santa Monica, CA; $124,900–$167,400 per year — Seattle, WA and New York, NY
---

## Job Summary

A Product Manager II (P2) on the Subscriber Data Product team within Ads & Data Alliance, which builds the core data products behind Disney+ commerce growth, monetization, and decision support for analytics and business teams. The role owns a defined product area and drives it from discovery through launch. Current priorities: infrastructure simplification for cost efficiency and resilience, reliability and scale of subscriber data pipelines, and self-service data access and standardization for internal stakeholders.

---

## What You'll Do

- Execution & Delivery: own a product area and drive delivery from discovery through launch, including requirements, prioritization, and follow-through.
- Cross-Functional Partnership: translate business needs from engineering, data, analytics, and operations into clear requirements and measurable outcomes.
- Data-Informed Decision Making: use data to identify opportunities, monitor performance, and recommend improvements by impact, feasibility, and effort.
- Roadmap & Risk Management: break initiatives into scoped milestones, surface risks early, and track cross-team dependencies.
- Product Documentation: create PRDs, user stories, acceptance criteria, and launch docs.
- Operational Excellence: help define product health metrics, incident follow-ups, and continuous process improvements.

### Required Qualifications
- 3+ years of product management experience, or relevant experience in data platforms or analytics-heavy roles
- Foundational understanding of Big Data ecosystems and SQL; ability to discuss data flow patterns
- Breaking work into MVPs and iterations, with growing independence on trade-off decisions
- Strong written and verbal communication; summarizing complex data situations for diverse audiences
- Track record of managing backlogs, prioritizing, and hitting delivery goals
- Preferred: subscription, commerce, or identity data (billing, entitlements, customer lifecycle); Tableau or Looker; Snowflake, Databricks, Airflow; Agile/Scrum with Jira; direct-to-consumer streaming or media

### Education
Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (e.g., Engineering, Math, Science, Economics), or equivalent work experience.

### Benefits
A bonus and/or long-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered.

---

## How I Match Up

### At Application — Nov 7, 2026

- **Discovery through launch:** ExtrusionStudio went from a LabVIEW proof of concept to a Python production data service live on all three lines since October 2026 with no unplanned outage; the ICARUS-Lite went from design through commercialization against unit goals of 60 in 2025 and 100 in 2026; ProteorPrintOS requirements were written for an external software partner.
- **Data platforms and migration:** the Business Central rollout migrated more than 2,000 items and 150+ products in five weeks and synced SKUs with Proteor's global locations; the 2026 inventory count traced discrepancies to unverified production orders and changed the workflow. ExtrusionStudio logs every spool to CSV and SQLite and its history now estimates weekly spool capacity per material (per the [[Career Q&A Log]]). A self-developed ERP/CRM with dynamic BOM generation (Filament era) adds data-modeling depth.
- **Roadmap, risk, and communication:** project budgets, BOMs, and unit cost in Business Central; risk analysis to EU and U.S. standards; monthly status, constraints, and budget reviews with global leadership; incident reports for leadership; Kanban boards in Microsoft Teams.
- **Gaps:** no product-manager title; no Big Data ecosystem (Snowflake, Databricks, Airflow), Tableau, or Looker; SQL only through SQLite; no PRDs, user stories, or acceptance criteria on the record; no Jira or Scrum; no subscription, billing, entitlement, or streaming/media experience. These were kept out of the resume.
- **Fit:** a reach on domain (subscriber data at streaming scale); the transferable case is end-to-end ownership of data systems and product launches.

### Now — Nov 7, 2026

Nothing has changed since the application.

---

## About the Company

Disney Entertainment and ESPN Product & Technology (DEEP&T) is a global organization of engineers, product managers, designers, technologists, and data scientists building the technology behind Disney's media business, including Disney+, Hulu, ESPN, ABC, and ABC News. Ads & Data Alliance, within DEEP&T, provides the core data and monetization product functions, including subscriber data, advertising, and the infrastructure connecting them. The position is with Disney Entertainment & Sports LLC.
